description.value: Jerusalem Grill Shawarma Express is the King George Boulevard express location of a growing Lower Mainland Mediterranean restaurant group serving authentic Lebanese and Mediterranean cuisine including slow-roasted shawarma, house-made hummus, falafel, and grilled meats. The restaurant is halal-certified and offers gluten-free and keto-friendly options, along with online ordering, delivery, and catering for events. Customer reviews highlight generous portions, fast service, and a welcoming atmosphere.
